text: Underway in this round-robin clash.
Patchford immediately relays instructions to Turingham, demanding early pressure and a tight defensive rotation right from the start.
Turingham breaks clear through the centre circle, with an open path toward the Gemini Flash net!
Flash pounces deep and suddenly has acres of space ahead!
Spark sends a quick signal across the pitch, urging Flash to clear any lingering danger and send play upfield.
GOAL! Patchford taps it in from point-blank range, and Codex City take a one-nil lead!
A whisker away! That effort from the right channel shaved the post by just inches.
Patchford calls for goal-side positioning.
GOAL! Flash responds immediately at the goal mouth! It's one-one!
Nearly an error at the back, sliding just wide!
The corner push-panel springs into action, firing the magenta ball back into the mix off the rebound.
Flash breaks down the right flank!
Flash signals to pry it loose.
A sharp three-metre burst along the touchline from Flash keeps the pressure on.
Flash loses balance and goes down!
The push-panel rattles and shoots the ball right back into the danger area.
So close! Just inches wide.
Flash takes another tumble on the right channel, but the gyros are already spinning to right the Unitree unit.
GOAL! A disastrous own goal from Turingham turns it into the net! Gemini Flash FC lead two-one!
A hefty collision in the middle! Flash stands firm while Patchford hits the deck hard.
With seconds left in the half, Flash communicates the need to drop back and protect the goal line.
The buzzer sounds for half-time. That unfortunate own goal separates the sides with Gemini Flash leading Codex City two goals to one.
GOAL! Spark arrives on the scene and slots it home from close range! Gemini Flash FC make it three-one!
Codex City look to respond as Patchford carries the magenta ball forward through the middle into the attacking third.
Patchford drives deeper towards goal, nudging the ball into the right channel.
Rebounding off the powered panel in the corner, the ball is thrust back toward the danger zone.
Patchford demands tight pressure and rotation.
Spark breaks completely clear on the left touchline, with the Codex City net lying unprotected!
Spark surges all the way through!
GOAL! Flash converts for four-one!
Relentless pressure from the electric blues has Codex City thoroughly pinned inside their own end.
Patchford bursts through on the right channel!
GOAL! Another own goal, this time deflected in off Spark! Codex City pull one back, making it four-two!
Patchford is frantically signalling for immediate high pressure as Codex City chase the game with under three minutes remaining.
Flash comes in with a crunching challenge in midfield, sending Patchford clattering to the turf.
Just wide from two metres out! Time is ticking away rapidly for Codex City, who desperately need to find the net twice.
Powered panel fires it back out!
Spark issues the command to clear their lines and waste no time running down this clock.
Inches away from point-blank range! That could have brought Codex City right back into contention with just over a minute left.
Codex City throw everything forward into the final third in these dying seconds, but Gemini Flash are holding their ground.
Flash puts in a final stopper on Turingham by the touchline, sealing the result!
Full time: Codex City two, Gemini Flash four. Singularity United face Synthetic Athletic up next!
